tools.name: search_cases
tools.description: Search DataArt case studies by text query and/or tag IDs with pagination. The query can be keywords or a whole question: it is split into words, common words are ignored, whole words are matched in the title, description and tag names (British/American spelling and plurals are folded). tools.name: get_case
tools.description: Get the full content of one case study (article text, challenge, solution, conclusion). The texts are Markdown. Pass the id, slug or url returned by search_cases.

tools.name: get_case_tags
tools.description: Get all available tags that can be used to filter case studies. Returns a list of tags with id, parentId, and title. The list is flat: parentId is always null. Use the tag ids in the search_cases tagIds parameter.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_case" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
